basis.postgresql_semantics: pg_has_role(u, r, 'MEMBER'|'USAGE'|'SET') for r distinct from u is true only if u is a superuser, or r is in the membership closure of u. That closure is built from pg_auth_members edges in which u (or a role u reaches) is the MEMBER, plus the implicit pg_database_owner membership of the current database's owner (datdba). USAGE and SET are further restrictions of MEMBER reachability, never wider.

authorized_observations_that_establish_i.PV-12 / MEMBERSHIPS: zero pg_auth_members edges with uellix_auditor as MEMBER
authorized_observations_that_establish_i.PV-19 / DATDBA: the current database's owner is not uellix_auditor

basis.conclusion: When all three hold, the closure of uellix_auditor is uellix_auditor alone, so pg_has_role is false for EVERY other role, including every uellix_cap_* role, whether or not it exists. No enumeration of pg_roles is needed or authorized.

structural_conditions: zero membership edges with uellix_auditor as MEMBER

COMMIT_OUTCOME_MODEL.problem: postgres.js begin() issues COMMIT after the callback, outside its try (node_modules/postgres/src/index.js scope()); a transport failure during COMMIT rejects begin() exactly as a callback failure does. The server may have committed. The client cannot tell, and E-9 plus PROHIBITED_SQL (no pg_authid) leave no authorized way to ask.

states.DEFINITELY_NOT_COMMITTED: Only when the client never requested COMMIT: the transaction never started, or the callback failed before completing (postgres.js then issues ROLLBACK and never COMMIT).
states.COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Every other failure once the callback has completed: explicit error on COMMIT, lost connection, timeout, transport ambiguity, or death of the process after the COMMIT request point. The conservative classification whenever 'never sent' cannot be proven.

COMMIT_OUTCOME_MODEL.N30_CUSTODY_UNDER_COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: When the outcome is COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN the candidate value is deposited into the N30 entry exactly as on COMMITTED (the value may be live, and a possibly-live value must be in the ratified store, never only in a process heap). The entry is RETAINED: it is not removed because an acknowledgement was lost. N11 is NOT closed and its act exit is NOT met; the lane STOPS.
COMMIT_OUTCOME_MODEL.RECONCILIATION_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: No authority defines how an unknown commit is reconciled. N13 (the only governed probe that would authenticate with the value) has N11's act exit as its precondition, which UNKNOWN does not meet; running it is therefore NOT authorized here. A successor authority must define reconciliation; until then the state is STOP with the candidate retained. This is a technical authority gap, not an owner policy choice.
COMMIT_OUTCOME_MODEL.carrier_lost: If the tool dies after the COMMIT request point before the depositor holds the value, the value may be live with no carrier. The only exits are ROTATE AGAIN (fresh HC-1) or PASSWORD NULL (its own confirmation), never automatic. VALID UNTIL bounds the exposure and substitutes for neither.

CERTIFICATION_EVENT_CONTRACT.rule: Generic: one event per certified candidate, at a path DERIVED from the candidate, so no path is consumed by one candidate and every successor candidate can be certified.

required_fields.candidate_commit: 40 hex; must equal the commit named by the path prefix
required_fields.verdict_class: one of PASS, PASS_WITH_NONBLOCKING_FINDINGS (terminal PASS classes); anything else is not a PASS
required_fields.package_closure_digest: sha256 over the sorted 'path:blob' lines of the execution package derived by scripts/custody/d1-package-closure.ts at the candidate

CERTIFICATION_EVENT_CONTRACT.authorized_post_certification_delta: Exactly ONE added file: the event itself. HEAD may be the candidate, or a descendant whose diff from the candidate is only that addition. Any other change (code, authority, record, test, config) is a new candidate that needs its own certification.
not_permitted: an event written by the author of the candidate
an event whose verdict_class is not a terminal PASS class
two events for one candidate that disagree

OPEN_EXECUTION_PRECONDITION_GAPS.gap: No authority requires measuring the hosted server's logging posture before N11. Parameter binding keeps the value out of statement TEXT; it does not keep it out of a server that logs bind parameters (log_statement = all, log_min_duration_statement with parameter logging, or an audit extension). No authorized read measures these settings. Recorded for a future authority; not a PRE-HC1 conjunct because no authority requires it and none can be satisfied by an authorized act today.

The external-observer topology of a consumer in --mode=execute cannot be demonstrated without a staging-host-shaped value in the WCM, which the synthetic custody shape forbids by design. The execute-mode loading path is exercised in-process and as a subprocess against a fake driver; the PEB-observed execute topology is nonblocking future evidence.
